checkpoint.criterion: >=99% of one league-week resolves to a game_id

measured_venue_facts.espn_dates_param_timezone: dates= is Eastern-scoped while event.date is UTC; over-fetch +/-1d and filter on UTC
measured_venue_facts.kalshi_close_time: close_time/expiration_time = scheduled start + EXACTLY 3 days (postponement buffer), NOT the start
measured_venue_facts.kalshi_expected_expiration: expected_expiration_time == occurrence_datetime == expected END of game
measured_venue_facts.kalshi_start_source: rules_primary states it in English; MLB alone includes a clock time (doubleheaders)
measured_venue_facts.kalshi_no_sub_title: equals yes_sub_title on 82/82 MLB markets - it is NOT the opposing team
measured_venue_facts.kalshi_custom_strike_uuid: stable per-team UUID; 30 distinct for 30 MLB teams, zero collisions
measured_venue_facts.pm_slug_date_is_not_game_date: mlb-stl-cin-2026-05-24 was PLAYED 2026-08-17; PM keeps the original slug on a postponed game while Kalshi re-mints on the new date
measured_venue_facts.pm_structured_fields: gameId, teams[].id, teams[].abbreviation, sport, startTime, markets[].gameStartTime, eventDate, period, score, live
measured_venue_facts.pm_start_authority: markets[].gameStartTime; agrees with Kalshi's ticker/rules time exactly
measured_venue_facts.epl_three_way: KXEPLGAME prices home/draw/away; 'Tie' is an outcome, not a participant (20/25 first-pass conflicts)
measured_venue_facts.epl_settlement_text: 'after 90 minutes plus stoppage time (does not include extra time or penalties)' - the soccer wedge, stated by the venue

corrections_to_plan.leagues_v1: plan named [nfl, nba]; NBA and NHL have ZERO games in this window and NFL is preseason. MLB is the only dense in-season US league. Stage 2 should run on MLB.
corrections_to_plan.false_alias_caught: auto-derived nfl 'la'->Rams (n=4) rejected: 'LA' denotes either LA club and the Chargers simply had not appeared with that label yet
